apps.message: Copies of Teams close right after opening in this Parallex. Update to 1.9.1 or later, or use Teams on the web meanwhile.

Arc keeps using its own profile in an instance, so the instance shares your Arc's sign-ins and cookies; with Own identity on, Arc closes at launch (it needs iCloud). Don't use Arc for a second account yet.
With Own identity on, Edge closes right after opening in this Parallex. Update to 1.9.1 or later, or leave Own identity off.
